title: How AI Is Changing the Way Small Businesses Work
content:
Artificial intelligence is becoming a practical tool for small businesses, helping them handle tasks that once required significant time and manual effort.

From customer communication and content creation to research, marketing, and everyday administration, AI can help businesses streamline repetitive work while allowing people to focus more on decisions, creativity, and customer relationships.

The important shift isn't simply using AI for the sake of using it. Businesses need to identify where technology can solve real problems, improve efficiency, and create a better experience for their customers.
